speaker: Doctor
text:
Since your spirometry shows obstruction but your methacholine challenge was normal, and the X-ray is clear, have you ever smoked or been exposed to significant environmental irritants? Additionally, do you experience symptoms specifically when lying flat or after meals?

speaker: Doctor

speaker: Doctor
text:
Given the normal pH esophagram and clear imaging, do you experience symptoms that worsen significantly during exercise or cold air exposure? Also, do you have a history of atopy or eczema?

REQUEST TEST: Exercise_Provocation_Test

speaker: Doctor
text:
That is surprising given your spirometry showed obstruction; have you noticed any changes in your voice or difficulty swallowing solids? Also, do you have a family history of early-onset emphysema or lung diseases?

REQUEST TEST: Genetic_Panels_Airway

speaker: Doctor
text:
Since your genetic panels and all imaging are normal, do you experience a distinct "ick" sensation in your throat or a need to clear your throat frequently? Also, does your shortness of breath improve when you take a deep breath compared to when you are at rest?

REQUEST TEST: Quantitative_Sweat_Test
REQUEST TEST: Serum_IgE

speaker: Doctor
text:
Given the extensive negative workup for asthma, COPD, reflux, and genetic conditions, and considering your report of a persistent cough with normal imaging, do you find yourself frequently clearing your throat or feeling as though you have a lump in your chest? Also, does this sensation improve when you take a sip of water?

DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Cough due to Laryngeal Sensitivity/Post-nasal Drip Syndrome (likely non-asthmatic eosinophilic cough or upper airway cough syndrome variant)
